name: Phulax — Per-tx detection on FakeLendingPool
description: Day-1 synthetic E2E: every block on 0G Galileo, query txs hitting FakeLendingPool, read exploit-corpus KV from 0G Storage, classify each tx via the self-hosted classifier endpoint, append a signed receipt to the 0G Storage incident log. Withdraw step is wired in once Track B6 ships the deployed FakeLendingPool address.
